name: contractguard-monorepo
description: ContractGuard — deterministic API contract compatibility analysis (monorepo root)

scripts.typecheck: tsc -b && tsc -p packages/core/test && tsc -p packages/openapi/test && tsc -p packages/engine/test && tsc -p packages/reporters/test && tsc -p packages/app/test && tsc -p packages/cli/test && tsc -p integrations/github-action/test
scripts.lint: eslint . && prettier --check . && pnpm run deps:check && pnpm run licenses:check
scripts.check: pnpm run build && pnpm run lint && pnpm run coverage
scripts.version-packages: changeset version && pnpm install --lockfile-only && pnpm build && pnpm --filter @zainkhan-bit/contractguard-github-action run bundle && pnpm docs:gen
